subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the rendering style of <Picture 1> and <Picture 2>: an epic cinematic graphic-novel illustration in full color, bold black ink outlines and confident brush inking, dramatic cel shading with deep shadows, a rainy navy night lit by sodium-orange lamps and a glowing doorway.
<Subject 2> is the masked man: a man in a black baseball cap, a black face mask over his nose and mouth, intense brown eyes, a black quilted puffer jacket, black cargo pants and a heavy gold Cuban link chain with a chunky gold pendant spelling "RMC". He moves fast and explosive, all coiled tension.
<Picture 1> is the first frame of [Shot 1], showing a close medium shot of the masked man crouching in a rain-soaked brick alley at night, a walkie-talkie pressed to his ear with his right hand, his eyes alert under the cap, the gold RMC chain on his chest, the glowing open door of the alley soft behind him on the right.
<Picture 2> is the last frame of [Shot 1], showing a wider shot of the alley: the masked man has risen out of the crouch into a forward lunge, his right arm swung down with the hand open and empty, his left hand clenched in a fist, the walkie-talkie bouncing on the wet cobblestones near the glowing door, the poster of a white-bearded old man and the white graffiti "O-Flo" on the brick wall at the right, rain falling through the lamplight.

detailed_description:
The target video is a living graphic-novel illustration in <Subject 1> with real energy: ink lines stay crisp, the rain keeps falling in bright streaks, and motion is sharp and weighty like a great music video.
[Shot 1] The shot begins from <Picture 1>, close on the masked man with the walkie-talkie at his ear. The walkie crackles with a burst of static; he presses the talk button and listens, and his eyes narrow as the voice on the other end gets to him. His brow knots in rage, he springs up out of the crouch, rips the walkie-talkie from his ear and hurls it down hard: it cracks against the wet cobblestones, the antenna whipping, a spray of puddle water and small black pieces bursting up as it bounces toward the glowing door. On the throw the camera jerks back and down in one fast continuous handheld pull-back, rain streaking past the lens, opening up the alley around him as he stands over the broken walkie with his arm still swung low and his fist clenched. The camera is still moving as the shot ends on <Picture 2>. No cut or transition occurs.

overall_soundscape:
Heavy rain hammering the alley, a crackle of radio static and a distorted voice on the walkie-talkie, his angry grunt, the hard crack of plastic on stone, a splash and the clatter of the walkie bouncing.
